results.title: Who is blind Ragi Harmandir Sahib?
results.snippet: Despite being blind, Bhai Gurmej Singh, a Hazoori Ragi at Sri Harmandir Sahib, achieved an extraordinary milestone by transcribing Guru Granth Sahib into Braille. After retiring from his job in 1998, he dedicated himself to this noble mission in 2000, completing it after 12 years of tireless effort.
